cohort: Medicaid patients who received an immediate postplacental intrauterine device after a third-trimester delivery between March 2, 2017, and September 2, 2019, were included.
finding: The overall documented intrauterine device expulsion rate within 1 year was 17.6%, with vaginal delivery being a significant risk factor for expulsion, and expulsion being associated with subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Patients who delivered vaginally were significantly more likely to experience intrauterine device expulsion within 1 year compared with those who had a cesarean delivery (adjusted odds ratio, 2.71).
gest_age: Included third-trimester deliveries; gestational age was controlled for in analysis.
